CustomField.description: The one applicant who may book this villa. Set from the back end; for them every other unit reads ineligible, for everyone else this unit reads taken. A pin RESTRICTS, it never frees: Is_Selectable__c still gates the pinned applicant too. Never serialized into any DTO and never granted to the guest permission set - the assignee must not reach a customer's browser. Cleared by the sweeper when the applicant expires.
CustomField.label: Pinned Applicant
